question:
As of 31st July 2025, which of the following country is the member of the Indian Ocean Rim Association?

I. Australia

Il. Bangladesh
solution: The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA):** The IORA is an intergovernmental organization established on **7 March 1997** to promote cooperation among countries bordering the Indian Ocean. • **Membership:** As of **31st July 2025**, IORA has **23 member states**. These include countries located along the Indian Ocean such as **Australia**, **Bangladesh**, India, South Africa, and others. • **Australia:** Australia is one of the founding members of the IORA and plays a significant role in regional cooperation, maritime security, and sustainable development. ***Hence, Statement I is correct.*** • **Bangladesh:** Bangladesh became a member of the IORA due to its geographical location bordering the Indian Ocean and its active participation in regional initiatives. ***Hence, Statement II is correct.*** • **Purpose:** The organization aims to enhance **economic cooperation, environmental protection, and maritime safety** among member states.
